environment.description: Rails 7.1 API running on Puma 6.x in single-mode (single process, multi-threaded) on an EC2 instance. The application is exposed directly via an NLB (Network Load Balancer) on port 443 with TLS termination at the NLB. No client certificate requirement. The ADMIN_TOKEN environment variable is set but the USR2 signal can be triggered by any process running as the same user (e.g., a cron job, sidecar, or container orchestrator health probe that sends signals). The application runs as a non-root user 'deploy' and other services on the same host also run as 'deploy'.

config.load_balancer: AWS NLB with TLS termination, no client cert validation
config.os_user: deploy (shared with cron and monitoring agents)
config.signal_exposure: Sidecar monitoring agent runs as same UID, sends periodic USR2 for credential rotation
